text:
Hi Mr Wälti,

I've got a few documents together for you. First my policy with CSS, which shows I'm covered for theft. Then the police report: I reported the theft on the evening of 25 July and asked them to investigate.

The theft was at home, at my house at Bergstrasse 37 in Glarus, on Saturday 25 July 2026, some time in the afternoon while I was at the pool with my son.

On receipts, I'm afraid I can't help. I don't have one for anything that was taken. The bike was a 50th birthday present from my brother-in-law, Leo Bachmann, who bought it in Germany and threw away the paperwork, and the helmet came from a shop in Zürich that's since closed. There's no way to get copies.

I've also filled in your claim form, which is attached as well.

What was taken is my bike, a silver men's trekking bike with 24 gears and an ordinary chain drive, no battery or motor, and the helmet that was hanging on the handlebars. I'd had it for just over two years and used it nearly every day.

The list of the two items with their values is the last attachment. It comes to CHF 2,400 in total.

Thanks very much,
Henry Bieri
